claim.claim-text: 1. A method for controlling a display device (215) to generate an image for viewing by a user on a head or helmet-mounted display, HMD, the display device having pixel-sized elements each separately controllable to reflect, emit or transmit light from one or more illuminating light sources, the image being formed by three light components displayed sequentially in three respective phases having predetermined relative timings defining equal time intervals between the respective phases in which the three light components are to be displayed, each light component comprising either a period of continuous illumination by one of said pixel-sized elements or a period comprising a set of light pulses according to a pulse width modulation, PWM, scheme, the method comprising the steps:
2. The method of claim 1 wherein the respective adjustment is proportional to an angular size in radians of a centre pixel of the display, s.
3. The method of claim 1 or claim 2 wherein the respective adjustment is proportional to Δt.

4. The method of any of claims 1, 2, or 3 wherein for each of the first and third light components, the two respective adjustments are determined as respective shifts in horizontal and vertical positions on the display.

5. The method of claim 4 wherein in step (iii), the position on the display for displaying each of the first and third light components is determined by applying the respective shifts in horizontal and vertical positions to respective pre-shifted x and y display positions.
6. The method of claim 5 wherein the shift in the horizontal position is proportional to rz, and the shift in the vertical position is proportional to ry.

7. The method of claim 6 wherein the image projection on the display is a flat surface projection, the shift in horizontal position is given by (s×Δt×rz)/cos<2>(Symx), and the shift in vertical position is given by (s×Δt×ry)/cos<2>(Symy).

8. The method of claim 6 wherein the image projection on the display is a spherical projection, the shift in horizontal position is given by s×Δt×rz, and the shift in vertical position is given by s×Δt×ry.

9. The method of any of claims 5-8, wherein the pre-shifted x and y display positions, XD and YD, are determined in the form of display coordinates, by transforming a line of sight vector PW to a point in inertial space into a line of sight vector PH to said point in a frame of reference of the HMD based on P H = HW P W
and converting the line of sight vector PH to the display coordinates based on X D = S y H x H Y D = S z H x H
where (XD, YD) are the display coordinates, xH, yH and zH are components of PH, and S is a scaling factor for the HMD.

10. The method according to any of the preceding claims wherein, at step (iii), determining a position for displaying the one or more light components comprises receiving data indicative of an orientation of the display in inertial space and determining a position on the display such that the feature appears aligned to a predetermined line of sight to a point in inertial space

11. The method according to claim 10, wherein the received rate data measure a rate of change in orientation of the display in inertial space and the measured rate is indicative of the rate of relative movement of the display relative to the direction of gaze of the user assuming that the direction of gaze of the user is substantially fixed in inertial space.

12. The method according to claim 10 or 11, wherein the received rate data define a rate of change in orientation of the display in azimuth and in elevation resolved in a frame of reference of the display, assuming no change in orientation of the display about a roll axis in the frame of reference of the display and assuming that the direction of gaze of the user is substantially fixed in inertial space.

13. A head or helmet-mounted display (HMD) system comprising a display device for generating images for display on a head or helmet-mounted display and an apparatus for controlling the display device, said apparatus comprising an image processor, the apparatus being arranged to implement the method according to any one of claims 1 to 12.

14. A computer program product comprising a computer-readable medium, or means for access thereto, having stored thereon computer program code which when loaded onto a digital processor and executed is arranged to implement the method according to any one of claims 1 to 12.

15. An apparatus for controlling a display device (215) to generate an image for viewing by a user on a head or helmet-mounted display, HMD, the display device having pixel-sized elements each separately controllable to reflect, emit or transmit light from one or more illuminating light sources, the image being formed by three light components displayed sequentially in three respective phases having predetermined relative timings defining equal time intervals between the respective phases in which the three light components are to be displayed, each light component comprising either a period of continuous illumination by one of said pixel-sized elements or a period comprising a set of light pulses according to a pulse width modulation, PWM, scheme, the apparatus comprising:

(a) to determine a position on the display for displaying each of the three light components of the feature including determining any respective adjustment required to a determined position for the light component according to the received rate data and the predetermined relative timings; and (b) to output the determined position of each of the three light components to the display device for display of the light component at the respective determined position,
